# English Hub

> Upper-intermediate to advanced English (B2 to C1) for Chinese-speaking adults: word chunks, grammar of choice, pronunciation, and groups of original articles on one topic. Every page reads in English, in Chinese, or in both.

All explanations, examples, articles and exercises are original work by VeryVisa. Coursebooks are referred to by unit only.

## Start here
- [index.html](https://veryvisa.github.io/english-hub/): the map and today's forty-minute session
- [books.html](https://veryvisa.github.io/english-hub/books.html): coursebook units matched to pages on this site
- [pains.html](https://veryvisa.github.io/english-hub/pains.html): what is hard for Chinese speakers, and where to practise it
- [words.html](https://veryvisa.github.io/english-hub/words.html): all words and chunks
- [tools.html](https://veryvisa.github.io/english-hub/tools.html): practice tools
